mapper.select:
select
SUBSTR(sci.pay_time,1,7) SUBSTR(sci.pay_time,1,10) AS wages_time, sci.employee_id,sei.nick_name,sum(service_wages) as wages_money from sys_card_info sci left join sys_employee_info sei on sci.employee_id=sei.employee_id where sci.order_status=2 and sci.employee_id is not null and sei.nick_name like concat('%',#{nickName},'%') and sci.pay_time like concat(#{wagesTime},'%') group by sci.employee_id,
SUBSTR(sci.pay_time,1,7) SUBSTR(sci.pay_time,1,10)

select
SUBSTR(sco.pay_time,1,7) SUBSTR(sco.pay_time,1,10)
AS pay_time,GROUP_CONCAT(sco.card_id) as card_id,sci.service_wages,sci.service_group,sco.pay_type,sco.pay_amount,count(1) as count from sys_card_order sco left join sys_card_info sci on sco.card_id=sci.card_id
and sci.employee_id = #{employeeId} and sco.pay_time like concat(#{payTime},'%')
GROUP BY sci.service_group,sco.pay_type,sco.pay_amount,
SUBSTR(sco.pay_time,1,7) SUBSTR(sco.pay_time,1,10)
order by sci.service_group,card_id,sco.pay_type

SELECT (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MIN(start), '%Y-%m-%d') FROM sys_card_info WHERE custom_id = #{customId} AND start IS NOT NULL) AS firstServiceDate, (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(start, '%Y-%m-%d') FROM sys_card_info WHERE custom_id = #{customId} AND start IS NOT NULL AND service_list IS NOT NULL AND service_list != '' AND service_list != 'null' ORDER BY start DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestServiceDate, (SELECT service_list FROM sys_card_info WHERE custom_id = #{customId} AND start IS NOT NULL AND service_list IS NOT NULL AND service_list != '' AND service_list != 'null' ORDER BY start DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestServiceName, (SELECT CASE WHEN sei.nick_name IS NULL OR sei.nick_name = '' THEN 'NAN' ELSE sei.nick_name END FROM sys_card_info sci LEFT JOIN sys_employee_info sei ON sci.employee_id = sei.employee_id WHERE sci.custom_id = #{customId} AND sci.start IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sci.start DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestEmployeeName
